intro: We hold a recorded main-programme fee of up to ₹{{budget}} lakh for {{count}} published MBA / PGDM colleges in India. This list is for students looking at the best MBA / PGDM colleges under ₹1 lakh.
Ranked colleges come first, then the rest are ordered by recorded total fee, lowest first. A low figure can be one-year tuition or a short course, so do not treat every card as a two-year MBA cost.
listLead: The list now opens with colleges whose recorded full-time programme total is at or below ₹1 lakh, starting with BK School of Business Management. IIT Delhi's full-time MBA tuition of ₹12 lakh is above this cap, so it is not on this budget list.
snapshot: Across the {{feeN}} published colleges here, the median recorded fee is {{feeMedian}}. The middle half sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.
Most listings are private ({{private}}), with {{public}} public institutes. Tamil Nadu, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Punjab, Rajasthan and Telangana have the most colleges on this budget list.
CAT is the exam most often linked here, followed by CMAT, TANCET and TS ICET. Use the list of top MBA / PGDM colleges in India 2026 as a shortlist, then confirm the official fee notice.
firstCollegesLead: IIT Delhi's official full-time MBA tuition is ₹12 lakh, so it is not on this under-₹1 lakh list. The first cards here are colleges whose recorded programme totals fall within the cap.

Later cards include Central University of Odisha at ₹17,220 and several Tamil Nadu private colleges at ₹17,500 or ₹20,500 in our records. Confirm whether those figures are one year or the full programme.

sections.heading: How to read an MBA fee under ₹1 lakh
paragraphs: A genuine two-year MBA at a well-known public institute is rarely this inexpensive, so a low card often reflects one-year tuition, a specialised diploma, or an incomplete record. Fees under ₹10,000 are treated as data errors and are not quoted as a minimum.
JNU’s MBA fee in our wider file is ₹359, which we do not treat as a usable figure. Always open the official fee notice before you budget.

compare.heading: How to compare the best MBA / PGDM colleges under ₹1 lakh
paragraphs: Start with the programme name, not the number, because a short course and a two-year MBA are not priced the same way.
Then check these points on the official site:
bullets: Whether the fee is for one year or the full two-year programme, and whether hostel or exam charges are included.
Whether the award is an MBA degree or a PGDM, and whether the programme is approved for the current year.
The entrance test used in the latest cycle, and the cut-off for your category.
The latest official placement report, treated as a historical record rather than a promise.

faqs.question: How many MBA colleges here have a fee under ₹1 lakh?
faqs.answer: {{count}} published MBA / PGDM colleges in our records have a main-programme fee of up to ₹{{budget}} lakh, and colleges without a recorded fee do not appear on this budget list.

faqs.question: Is IIT Delhi’s MBA really under ₹1 lakh?
faqs.answer: No. IIT Delhi's official full-time MBA tuition is ₹12 lakh, which is above this cap, so it is not on this list.

faqs.question: What is the typical fee on this under-₹1-lakh list?
faqs.answer: Among the {{feeN}} published colleges here, the median recorded fee is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half falls between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.

faqs.question: Why are some very low MBA fees not shown as the minimum?
faqs.answer: Fees under ₹10,000 are treated as data errors in our system and are not quoted as a minimum, including a JNU MBA figure of ₹359 in our wider file.

faqs.question: Are these low fees always for the full two-year MBA?
faqs.answer: Not always, because some cards look like one-year tuition or a shorter programme, so confirm the official fee notice before you shortlist a college on price alone.
